routes.label: registration at an NRB office or registration centre; issued within 30 days

note: The NRB registers every citizen of 16 and over for the card, issued within 30 days of application. Asked what registering costs, its FAQ answers only that replacement fees (for loss, damage or expiry) are set in the gazette and suspended for now; registering after 30 working days of turning 16 draws a late fee. The first card's fee isn't stated, so it's null; the card expires, the FAQ says, but its term isn't stated, so that's null too.

sources.title: National Registration Bureau (Malawi), FAQs
sources.said: Citizen above 16 years for National Identity Card ... The National ID Card shall be issued within 30 days of application ... 24.What will it cost me to register and get my National ID card? The fee for the replacement of National ID card is set in the gazette. However, at the moment, the government of Malawi suspended all the fees for replacement of National ID cards due to loss, damage or expiry.

sources.title: National Registration Bureau (Malawi), National ID
sources.said: For late registration (after 30 working days upon turning 16 years of age), Registration Officer advises applicant to pay stipulated late registration fee.
